Name: Yes We're Dating--Haley
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1][size=3]Are you tired of your girlfriend/boyfriend's dialogue after you start dating defaulting to the normal dialogue, or the dating dialogue you do see not really being up to par?
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]Well, this mod aims to help with that!
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]With this mod, during seasons [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]Winter through Summer[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3], you will see dating dialogue from [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]Haley[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]. I've determined you'd probably hit 8 hearts around Winter, which is why I've started dialogue during Winter! (if requested, I might add dialogue for Fall too for a year long dating experience--let me know!)
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]By default, Haley will [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]occasionally[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3] acknowledge if your [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]player's gender is the same as hers[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3], therefore if you play as a female farmer, she will mention it in her dialogue. If you'd prefer to have her [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]not mention[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3] your farmer's gender, you can turn this off via Generic Mod Config Menu.
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]You will see 65+ new lines of dialogue, including:
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]-3 [u]random[/u] variations of 8 heart dialogue for each day of the week in [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]Winter
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]-3 [u]random[/u] variations of 10 heart dialogue for each day of the week in [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]Spring
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]-3 [u]random[/u] variations of 10 heart dialogue for each day of the week in [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]Summer[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
3 [u]random[/u] variations of Rainy dialogue
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]-and some [/size][/color][color=#ff00ff][size=3]proposal[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3] dialogue!

[/size][/color][size=2](She will start getting impatient on [color=#ff00ff]Sundays[/color] in [color=#ff00ff]Summer[/color] if you haven't proposed to her, but i find it to be part of her charm lol)
[/size][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]I have plans to release a mod for each Bachelor/ette, and possibly release one big multipack mod when/if they all get done. Please enjoy, and let me know if there's anything that needs fixing or any suggestions you may have. Thank you![/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Yes We're Dating--Haley
Manifest.Description: Dating dialogue pack for Haley for players who actually want to date her.
Manifest.Author: Kettuluv
